newsitem.title: SWEDEN: ABN Amro names new Swedish, Finnish treasury head.
newsitem.headline: ABN Amro names new Swedish, Finnish treasury head.

text.p: ABN Amro Bank said on Wednesday that it had appointed a new Director of Treasury for its Swedish and Finnish banking operations.
ABN Amro Sweden and Finland General Manager Brian Murphy told Reuters the bank had appointed Lars Erbom, currently part of Erbom and Carlsson Currency Management.
He has formerly worked in a senior role for Sweden's S-E-Banken.
"His experience and market contacts will be invaluable assets to ABN Amro in continuing to build up a significant presence in the Swedish and Finnish markets," Murphy said.
Erbom is expected to begin work with ABN Amro in Stockholm in January.

ABN Amro's banking division in the two countries employs about 120 people. With the Alfred Berg Group, which is owned by the Netherlands-based bank, between 400 and 500 people are employed in Sweden and Finland.
